subject: 亡くなられたかたへの弔意
evidence: A quiet mourning scene at dusk on a hilltop in Setana, Hokkaido, in late spring: the petals of a small bunch of white chrysanthemums on a weathered wooden rail tremble faintly in a soft breeze, facing out over forested hills toward the Sea of Japan, while the violet-orange light along the horizon slowly deepens.
reason: ナレーションは追悼の心情を述べる抽象文であり、白い菊を供えた情景で象徴的に表している。
